proposed_capabilities.helper_authority: spawn exactly one named reviewer helper and call that same helper for exactly three review passes

shared_content_contract: The result is a compact essay, not a slide deck.
Use readable body text and materially more explanatory prose than the existing eight-page drafts.
Keep chapters 1 and 2 substantially intact but edited for compression.
Replace only the chapter 2 sequence list with an explanatory recursive visualization.
Give section 3 enough prose to explain context loss, partial familiar framings, five independent paths, and upward/downward traversal.
Give level 4 enough prose and figures to explain responsibility planes, the strategy-to-Dispatch control spine, execution and durable record, one governed-run example, and unresolved boundaries.
Figures support or compress the prose; they do not replace necessary explanation.
Clearly distinguish essay-backed properties, proposed services, and unresolved ownership.
Use ASCII hyphens only and claim no more than evidence supports.
Reopen the PDF, render every page, inspect full-size pages plus contact sheet, and fix clipping, overlap, blank pages, glyph defects, and unreadable labels.

shared_reviewer_profile.mode: single P11 read-only inline helper within creator scope

proposed_capabilities.read: the four frozen sources and fixed files beneath the creator's exact version folder

anti_bias_global: Across capacity-bounded waves, oppose source-faithful continuity, forensic traceability, formal navigability, spatial efficiency, and operational failure visibility.

groups.pairwise_prediction: creator-03-a runs historical reconstruction while creator-04-a runs adversarial provenance audit on the methodology axis; a bias in creator-03-a toward visual resemblance without accountable semantics would be exposed by creator-04-a, while a bias in creator-04-a toward exhaustive ledger structure without natural reading flow would be exposed by creator-03-a.

seats.angle: Historical reconstruction of the polished-diagrams visual grammar, extended through necessary information-bearing figures and spatially quiet artistic marks.
seats.prompt_template: Create Version 03, Polished Diagrams Plus, in the exact assigned folder. Use only bound local sources and approved local tools. Preserve the polished source's cream paper, black editorial serif, rust accents, fine rules, corner marks, and calm pacing. Produce a text-rich 9-10 page compact essay. Keep chapters 1 and 2 substantially intact; replace the sequence list with one recursive composition figure. Expand section 3 with clear prose around context loss, familiar partial framings, five paths, and complementary traversal. Make level 4 a detailed prose-and-diagram infrastructure x-ray with status boundaries and one governed run. Add figures only when they improve explanation; artistic traces must consume no meaningful content space. Spawn exactly one helper, Rumelt, Richard, using model gpt-5.6-sol with no inherited turns. The helper reads only fixed files in this folder and bound sources, writes nothing, and returns the frozen review response. Complete exactly three review-revision passes, record them in review-log.md, then visually verify all outputs.
seats.reviewer_prompt_template: Review the current fixed Version 03 folder and four bound sources. Do not write. Return no more than five findings using page, evidence, correction, plus one allowed verdict. Attack source-design fidelity, whether every figure earns its space, ornamental restraint, prose sufficiency, five-path semantics, hypothesis boundaries, print readability, and render integrity.

scheduling.wave_rule: Only one two-seat creator wave runs at a time. Its two creators run concurrently, leaving one slot for one reviewer helper at a time. Wave C runs after Wave B.
scheduling.helper_rule: Each creator spawns exactly one reviewer and reuses it for three passes; reviewers never fan out and never persist an independent deliverable.

partition_check.non_overlapping: Each seat owns one exact folder and one distinct explanatory methodology.
partition_check.covering: The five positions cover source continuity, traceability, navigability, spatial efficiency, and operational failure visibility - the five design tensions requested for comparison.
